mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering the primordial gas was most worthwhile: it connected gravity to star formation while explaining why a bound region need not expand with the universe.

leastWorthwhile.text: The light-release sequence was somewhat confusing: my first two attempts did not use the expected pairs, though compatibility feedback advanced both actions.

surprise.text: I was surprised that transparency arrived before the first stars, as neutral gas left fewer free electrons to scatter the ancient light.

arbitrary.text: I initially expected neutral hydrogen to release the light directly; needing primordial gas instead was not obvious from the introduction, although the resulting explanation clarified the process.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the dense gas loses heat and develops into stars; the brief explanations made the natural processes engaging.
